title: Chaldean and Sumerian traditions of gods escaping the great catastrophe
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Chaldean and Sumerian traditions of gods escaping the great catastrophe, about prehistoric cataclysm at Mesopotamia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, there are traditions going back to the Calaldanss to the Samrians.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient catastrophes, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that there are traditions going back to the Chaldeans and Sumerians, ancient peoples of Mesopotamia, about gods who escaped a great catastrophe long ago. He tells it as a hint that old myths may remember a real disaster and beings who got away from it.
